name: Kagetsuin Noa
source:
Likes: People who look deeper into others
Dislikes: People who only judge others by appearance

Itsuki's upperclassman who is friendly towards everyone and anyone, and is very trusted by the teachers thanks to this. She is the president of the handicrafts club. Loves all kinds of emotions.
